cell_kind: ROLLOUT -- raw grouped-Solver samples for downstream curation (S3-3 scoring, S3-4 semantic advantage); no admission verdict is read from this cell
claim_boundary: No superiority, generalisation, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim of any kind. This cell exists to produce five custodied Solver samples per row; S3-6's eventual TRAIN A delta-store cell carries the only gating claim in the loop.

decision_rule.rule: NONE -- this cell has no gating decision rule (preregistration section 4). Its output is read by scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py, not by a plan_cell_read.py admission read.

stages.render: one outputs copy per Solver sample index (0..4), the row's own solver_group.samples[index].parsed_answer rendered through the canonical analysis.native_commit_replay.replay_row form; a copy is written once and read back on every later invocation.
stages.score: each of the five copies scored ONCE through the registered scorer named in --scorer-id (default slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train, the v3-projected sibling of this cell's own online scorer slurp-slu-official-train -- the delivered text here carries no deliver_normaliser, so the projection this cell's Solver samples would otherwise lack is applied OFFLINE at this step); never core.scoring_batch, which scores a bundle-verified run directory and every side here is a derived copy with no manifest and no bundle.
stages.pairs: per row: best/worst sample by (slu_f1_f1, scenario_action_exact) with a deterministic ascending-sample_index tie-break, disagreement = best - worst; rows with disagreement > 0 become S3-4's advantage-contact roster; a per-scenario coverage table from the roster's own stratum field; the delivered (committed) answer's own official score is read from the sealed <run_id>.scores.json, never rescored.

downstream_read.output: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLLOUT-R01-SCORE-V1/ under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR: per_row.json, pairs.json, per-copy outputs jsonl and score jsonl, all sha256-pinned; contacts block {model:0,...,scorer:5}.

execution_profile: model-free-check (the downstream read); bounded-discovery-probe (this cell's own flight)
row_accounting_required: 800 in, 800 out on the roster side; every row's solver_group carries exactly 5 samples in custody (I7g); the commit replay of the registered plurality-support policy over the raw samples reproduces the sealed delivered answer's own official counts (the same licence proof scripts/analysis/slurp_verifier_measurement.py's stage_rollouts uses for the B2 v3 precedent).
what_is_not_here: No generation-plan / fit-plan / protocol-registered JSON siblings: those bind a REAL prepared phase supply and a REAL promoted-packet identity, neither of which exists while the roster-bound PENDING placeholders (configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-rollout-baseline-v1.json's stage3_pending_placeholders block) are open. Root mints them once the placeholders resolve.
